Savings account rates

You'll find all of our current savings rates here. We take great pride in offering some of the highest savings rates in Canada, so that you can make the most of your hard-earned money.

Type Current rate (%)
Savings Account 2.80
TFSA Savings Account 2.80
RSP Savings Account 2.80
Spousal RSP Savings Account 2.80

Savings account interest rates are annualized, calculated daily and paid monthly. Interest rates are subject to change at any time without notice.

Ready to start investing? Get started

Each deposit is available through either Home Bank or Home Trust Company, both of which are separate members of CDIC.
The rates in the table have been in effect since October 02, 2026 .

Savings account rates

With our non-registered savings account, you’ll enjoy no fees and no minimum balance requirements. Also, there are no limitations on the number of transactions you can make using this type of savings account. For our registered savings accounts, there is also no minimum balance requirements but you will only have a set number of transactions that are free within a given period. Both types of savings accounts are eligible for CDIC coverage, up to all applicable limits, so you know your money is always safe.
